rawContent: Law enforcement has failed victims of sexual misconduct and abuse for years and the #MeToo is how we fight back. Without it, invincible men in power will never have to face the consequences of their action.

A: Not all men are trash! Stop judging an entire group based on the actions of a few!

Also A: I've heard cases of those who make false allegations, using the #MeToo movement to smear people they don't like. Therefore, the entire movement is stupid and harmful.
